title: internal/runstate's maintenance negative-control fixture cannot arm on this host's git, failing at base
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails with "a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing" — the fixture that must prove the guard is load-bearing arms maintenance in a way this host's git (auto-maintenance on fetch) no longer triggers, so the test fails before it tests anything. Reproduced at be3b46ba with the tick's changes stashed, so it is not this tick's; it is a git-version-dependent fixture, green presumably on CI's git.
